scope: Matched-retained-reference sizing: offline projection of existing v4 accepted non-table selection citations to compact page-local reference ranges, merged per role. Not generated by a reference-only selector; no claim of maintained semantic quality or future runtime. Canonical tables retained automatically. Proposals lacking current-chunk refs counted explicitly; audit artifacts built in memory only, never saved as real pipeline stages. New helper not integrated.
proxy_limitations: Uses only historically retained references to isolate representation cost. This is NOT a proposed production filter: reproducing the old rejected-summary filter would lose useful original source evidence.
Topic label is fixed other_relevant_context in projection; actual model topics, unresolved refs and selection quality are unmeasured.
No fixed evidence-count cap; larger actual selections can require longer completions or more module hierarchy.
Initial module calls measured only; downstream synthesis/review/gold costs not included.
Baseline selection input includes any final repair chat; fresh reference input does not.
